items.title: Four arrested after police officer injured in shooting
items.summary: The officer was shot in the foot and remains in hospital in a stable condition, police say.

items.title: Australian MP in critical condition after being hit by car - as counter-terror police investigate
items.summary: An Australian MP has been attacked outside her office and is in a critical condition, the country's prime minister Anthony Albanese has said.

items.title: 'Postcode lottery' driving children's inequality in England, commissioner warns
items.summary: Dame Rachel De Souza's landmark report says children are being failed by a "postcode lottery".

items.title: Two men and two women arrested after police officer shot
items.summary: Two men and two women have been arrested after a police officer was shot and injured in Nottingham city centre at the weekend.

items.title: PM says youth unemployment is a 'catastrophe and a moral failure'
items.summary: The UK faces "economic catastrophe" with one million young people not in work or training, the prime minister says.

items.title: Police investigate 'non-viable' bomb threats sent to schools in Northern Ireland
items.summary: Police are investigating bomb threats sent to 160 schools in Northern Ireland, which are not being treated as viable.
